climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A northern Mendocino County AVA in canyons holding two rivers, where marine breezes keep summers cooler and winters warmer than inland areas to the east. As of 2023 only six acres of commercial vineyard are planted.
